quickref.name: Shortest Parsec
quickref.era: Added in Battle Bears (BBR line) iOS update 1.4.2 on Feb 28, 2013, after a Jan 10, 2013 teaser for a "New Space Station map!" [Game text via wiki]. Carried into BBG from 1.0 (May 24, 2013) [Fan-wiki] and still in BBG in 2021 screenshots [Observed]. No rework or removal documented.
quickref.in_2026: 2026 soundtrack track 9 "Shortest Parsec" (1:13) [Canon]. Shown in the official Steam trailer at 24.0–28.25 s and 49.5–51.75 s, and in Steam screenshots screen_02 and screen_04 [Observed]. Not named in the Steam store text. Inclusion at launch is likely but unconfirmed [Inference].
quickref.setting: A space station with almost no walls, floating in a starfield [Game text via wiki; Fan-wiki]. Per SkyVu's blurb, a "private arms dealer" uses it "to transfer power to its facilities" on "a mysterious planet on the fringes of the known galaxy", near where "a robotic someone" exploded [Canon per notes; Unverified this session]. H.I.P. emblems appear on the floor and walls [Fan-wiki; Observed]. Tagline: "In space, EVERYONE can hear you scream."
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Near-black space #000004–#0F081A with dense white stars, an indigo-violet band #160D38 and a violet-magenta nebula #46163C behind the tower windows. Lavender-white hulls #98A6F1 / #727AA8. Glossy red tower panels #FF1B28 with mint-white light bars. Orange-gold beam (core #FFFF8F, pad rim #FFA26F) from a periwinkle hex emitter #B1B1E5. Red hall walls #982029 over a slate floor #131D26, with door glows #FF3A55 (red side) and #924FFF (blue side). Teal asteroids #006F7D, cyan jump pads #4ACCE2, green console #2F9957. No sun; team-coloured practical lights; warm spill from the beam [Observed].
quickref.landmarks: 1) Red-panelled laser tower firing a periodic orange cone onto a round pad between the two spawns. 2) White central module ('middle dome') with a red interior hall, an open roof slot, a red-lit door on one side and a purple-lit door on the other. 3) Spine walkway with a large red H.I.P. floor medallion. 4) Far switch tower ('meteor tower'): cracked red floor, lime-green console, black cable with a skewered Huggable, outline H.I.P. engraving on its wall. 5) Faceted teal asteroids with hexagonal holes. 6) L-shaped red and blue team arms with dashed running lights [Observed].
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: Hazards: the void at every edge, and frequent suicides [Fan-wiki]. The laser fires on a timer, cannot be controlled and damages anyone under it [Fan-wiki]. A melee-hit switch on the far tower moves the central floor to drop players, even teammates [Fan-wiki]. Jump-pad stall bug [Fan-wiki]. Plant the Bomb bombs sit on the bottom platform under the far tower [Fan-wiki]. Easter eggs: "YOU SHOULDN'T BE ABLE TO READ THIS!" written twice on the laser-tower roof with two bear faces and five stars [Observed; Fan-wiki]; climbable meteorite tops [Fan-wiki]; "Killerbear500" graffiti on a purple-lit wall [Observed]; a Huggable corpse [Fan-wiki]; H.I.P. emblems [Observed].

corrections.current_text: - **The H.I.P. logo** (a Vitruvian-style Huggable in a circle) appears on Space Oddity [Observed: Steam screen_02]. It was **not** seen in any H.I.P. Test Lab image I opened [Observed].
corrections.correction: Steam screen_02 is Shortest Parsec, not Space Oddity, so the H.I.P. emblem should be listed under Shortest Parsec. There it appears as a red floor medallion on the spine walkway and as an outline engraving on the switch-tower wall.
corrections.evidence: screen_02 shows the laser tower with red panels, the orange beam onto a round pad, a cracked red floor with a green console and the red emblem medallion. These match the wiki's Shortest Parsec images: File:New_map_1.jpg and File:New_map_3.jpg (the BBR 1.4.2 previews), File:Scary_Light.png, File:ShortestParsecEasterEgg3.png (the same floor medallion) and the overhead File:Shortest_Parsec.jpg. The wiki's H.I.P. page also says the Shortest Parsec map "has their symbol on a large tower".

corrections.current_text: - Only the Huggable can reach the Shortest Parsec Easter egg.
corrections.correction: Label this a contested fan claim. The Huggable (BBG) wiki page says only the Huggable can reach "the map's Easter Egg". The Shortest Parsec page lists several Easter eggs, and says the red-base meteorite "can be reached only by using So Fly[Huggable] and Metal Crush[B-1000]", with some players claiming a Jump Pro Mode double jump plus Turkish Jump Boots.
corrections.evidence: Fan wiki through the API: the Shortest Parsec page (Trivia) and the Huggable (BBG) page (Trivia). The Metal Crush page also says an Assault can "jump from the tower on Shortest Parsec to either team's spawn points".

corrections.current_text: - It can reach places no other class can, such as the Shortest Parsec Easter egg [Fan-wiki].
corrections.correction: Only the Huggable (BBG) wiki page claims this. The Shortest Parsec page says the red-base meteorite can be reached with So Fly (Huggable) or Metal Crush (B-1000), and some players claim the Turkish Jump Boots double jump works too.
corrections.evidence: Fan wiki: the Shortest Parsec page Trivia; the Huggable (BBG) page Trivia; the Metal Crush page Trivia.

corrections.current_text: | 24.0–27.5 s | Missile-cam of an olive shell approaching a space station.
corrections.correction: Name the map: the station is Shortest Parsec. The red-and-white room the canister drops into is its central module (the wiki's "middle dome").
corrections.evidence: Trailer frames at 24.5 s and 25.5 s show, from above, the layout of the wiki's overhead File:Shortest_Parsec.jpg: the laser tower with its orange emblem, the red and blue L-shaped arms, the white central module, the walkway with the red H.I.P. medallion and the teal asteroid. My frames are /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/maps/dl/shortest_parsec/frames/a_04.jpg and a_08.jpg.

corrections.current_text: the camera rides the olive bomb with its yellow band down onto a space station.
corrections.evidence: Same as the visuals_2026.md item: trailer 24.0–28.25 s is Shortest Parsec (frames a_02–a_19).

corrections.current_text: - **Shockwaves** are flat octagonal rings on the ground, white on the space station and orange in the cave
corrections.correction: "white on Shortest Parsec". Also note that the octagonal glow around the central module in screen_02 is this weapon VFX, not map geometry.
corrections.evidence: In my 4 fps frames, the ring is absent at 49.75–50.25 s (b_03–b_05) and appears with the explosion from 50.5 s (b_06). The station is Shortest Parsec (laser tower and switch tower visible).
